items.title: Avast Antivirus Sandbox Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Escalate Privileges
items.description: Security researchers from the SAFA team have uncovered four kernel heap overflow vulnerabilities in Avast Antivirus, all traced to the aswSnx kernel driver. The flaws, now tracked collectively as CVE-2025-13032, could allow a local attacker to escalate privileges to SYSTEM on Windows 11 if successfully exploited.
